# React Native World

> Documentação pessoal de estudos de React Native, escrita do ponto de vista de uma desenvolvedora Android nativa (Kotlin). Cada seção mapeia um conceito do Android/Kotlin para o equivalente em React Native, TypeScript e Web (Next.js). Três destinos de entrega: app nativo, navegador mobile e site.

Site: https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/

## Introdução

- [Introdução](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/intro): Visão geral do guia e a organização por segmentos de estudo.

## Fundamentos

- [Arquitetura](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/fundamentos/arquitetura): Bridge vs Nova Arquitetura (JSI, Fabric, TurboModules, Codegen, Yoga) — analogia com JNI.
- [Expo vs RN CLI](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/fundamentos/expo-vs-rn-cli): Caminho gerenciado (Expo/EAS/Prebuild) vs bare workflow.
- [Metro Bundler](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/fundamentos/metro-bundler): O bundler/dev server do RN — analogia com Gradle e Apply Changes.

## Linguagem: Kotlin → TypeScript

- [Tipos e Null Safety](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/linguagem/tipos-e-null-safety): data class vs interface, optional chaining, nullish coalescing.
- [Coroutines vs Async](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/linguagem/coroutines-vs-async): suspend/Flow/Dispatchers vs async/await/Promise/AbortController.
- [Padrões e Estruturas](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/linguagem/padroes-e-estruturas): sealed class vs discriminated union, coleções, extension functions.

## UI e Layout

- [Componentes Básicos](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/ui/componentes-basicos): Tabela Views/Compose → componentes RN (View, Text, Pressable, TextInput).
- [Flexbox (Yoga)](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/ui/flexbox-yoga): LinearLayout/ConstraintLayout → flexDirection, justifyContent, alignItems.
- [Estilos e StyleSheet](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/ui/estilos-stylesheet): styles.xml/dimens/themes → StyleSheet.create e tokens de tema.
- [Listas](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/ui/listas): RecyclerView/Adapter/DiffUtil → FlatList, FlashList, renderItem.
- [Animações e Gestos](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/ui/animacoes-e-gestos): Animated, Reanimated (worklets na UI thread) e Gesture Handler vs MotionEvent.
- [Imagens e Mídia](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/ui/imagens-e-midia): drawable/Glide vs Image require/uri, resizeMode≈scaleType, assets e fontes.

## Ciclo de Vida e Estado

- [Ciclo de Vida](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/estado/ciclo-de-vida): onCreate/onResume/onDestroy vs mount/useEffect/AppState.
- [Gerenciamento de Estado](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/estado/gerenciamento-de-estado): ViewModel/StateFlow vs useState, Zustand, Context, React Query.
- [DI e Context](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/estado/di-e-contexto): Hilt/Koin vs Context API e providers.

## Navegação

- [React Navigation](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/navegacao/react-navigation): Intents/NavGraph vs Stack/Tab/Drawer, deep links, parâmetros tipados.

## Dados

- [Rede e HTTP](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/dados/rede): Retrofit/OkHttp/Moshi vs fetch/axios/Zod.
- [Armazenamento Local](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/dados/armazenamento): SharedPreferences/DataStore/Room vs AsyncStorage/MMKV/SQLite/Realm.
- [TanStack Query](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/dados/tanstack-query): Client vs server state, useQuery/useMutation, cache e invalidação — Repository+Flow.

## Mundo Nativo

- [TurboModules](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/nativo/turbo-modules): Módulos nativos em Kotlin chamados pelo JS — Codegen + JSI.
- [Gradle e Builds](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/nativo/gradle-e-builds): A pasta android/ como projeto Gradle normal, autolinking, assinatura.
- [APIs do Sistema](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/nativo/apis-do-sistema): Acessibilidade, Linking, permissões, NetInfo, sensores.
- [Fabric Components](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/nativo/fabric-components): View nativa customizada exposta ao JS — ViewManager e codegenNativeComponent.
- [Notificações e Background](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/nativo/notificacoes-e-background): FCM/push, canais, Headless JS e trabalho em background vs WorkManager.

## Tooling e Qualidade

- [Debugging](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/tooling/debugging): Logcat/breakpoints/inspector vs DevTools, LogBox, adb logcat.
- [Testes](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/tooling/testes): JUnit/Espresso/Robolectric vs Jest/RNTL/Maestro/Detox.
- [Por Plataforma](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/tooling/codigo-por-plataforma): Platform.OS, arquivos .android.tsx/.ios.tsx, permissões.
- [Performance](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/tooling/performance): Perf Monitor (UI vs JS FPS), Hermes profiling, bundle size vs Android Profiler/Systrace.

## RN na Web

- [Mapa dos Destinos](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/web/mapa-dos-destinos): Um código, três destinos — app nativo, navegador mobile e site. Tabela-mestra.
- [React Native Web](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/web/react-native-web): View/Text → DOM, o que funciona e o que não, expo start --web.
- [WebView e Navegadores](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/web/webview-e-navegadores): WebView nativa/JavascriptInterface vs react-native-webview/postMessage.
- [Next.js Fundamentos](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/web/nextjs-fundamentos): App Router, rotas por arquivo, server vs client components.
- [Server Actions e Dados](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/web/server-actions-e-dados): fetch em Server Components, cache/revalidate, Server Actions e Route Handlers.
- [SSR / SSG / CSR](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/web/renderizacao-ssr-ssg): Estratégias de renderização e hidratação na web.
- [Projeto Universal](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/web/projeto-universal): Monorepo app RN + site Next.js com Solito/Tamagui.
- [Navegação e Links](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/web/navegacao-e-links): React Navigation vs App Router; deep links e App Links ↔ URLs.
- [Deploy e PWA](https://guerraana.github.io/react-native-world/docs/web/deploy-e-pwa): Build web, Vercel/hosting, PWA instalável e SEO.

- TypeScript: https://www.typescriptlang.org/docs/
- React Navigation: https://reactnavigation.org/docs/getting-started
- Expo: https://docs.expo.dev/
- React Native Web: https://necolas.github.io/react-native-web/
